context: A police officer discusses a case
purpose: Teach: 撲滅/亡くなる/身柄/漢方/災い/収縮/密輸/無差別

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、犯罪撲滅、絶対、目指してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are committed—truly committed—to eliminating crime. Thank you for your dedication.
lines.style: Steady, formal opening. Measured cadence befitting official statement. Slight emphasis on commitment words. Professional warmth, not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、被害者の方、絶対、亡くなる前に、絶対、警察に、絶対、通報されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the victim did report this to police before—before what happened. That took courage.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. Quiet respect for the victim's agency. Pause before the difficult part. Genuine curiosity, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の身柄、本気で、絶対、確保いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've secured the suspect. That much we've confirmed.
lines.style: Clear, procedural. No flourish. Each phrase lands with the weight of fact. Professional distance maintained but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者、本気で、絶対、漢方医、絶対、利用していた、絶対、と、聞きました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand the victim had been consulting a traditional herbalist. Is that correct?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry. Checking facts without accusation. Respectful of the victim's choices. Pace slightly slower—this detail matters.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、災いを、絶対、繰り返さないよう、絶対、警察、絶対、頑張ります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. And we're working to ensure nothing like this happens again. That's our responsibility.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Not defensive, but determined. Speaks to duty more than reassurance. Small breath before the last sentence—it means something to him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 血管の収縮、本気で、絶対、被害者の死因、絶対、関係していたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The vascular complications—they were significant to what happened. We're still investigating that connection.
lines.style: Careful, technical but not cold. Acknowledges the medical complexity. Measured pacing. Respect for the victim underneath the procedural language.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者、本気で、絶対、密輸、絶対、関与、絶対、容疑、絶対、調べております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect is being investigated for smuggling involvement in connection with this case. We're looking into all angles.
lines.style: Formal update. Each detail precise. Not rushed. The gravity of the criminal charge settles in the delivery. Professional composure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 無差別、本気で、絶対、犯罪、絶対、本当に、絶対、許せない、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、お疲れ様
lines.en: Crimes like this—indiscriminate, senseless—they're unforgivable. Thank you for the work you're doing. Thank you for caring.
lines.style: Softens slightly from before. Genuine emotion under control. Voice steadies on 'unforgivable.' Closing gratitude is sincere, almost vulnerable. Respect between them.
